results.description: Copy every source buy and mirror source sell fractions.
Copy all buys only in campaigns with no source sell before the first observed buy.
Copy only campaigns where deep attribution sees him as buyer rank 1-2.
Copy only campaigns where detected entry age is 10 seconds or less.
Copy all except campaigns where he entered after a small early crowd, rank 3-25.
Copy only source buy legs of at least 3 SOL.
Copy only 3+ SOL buy legs when he is first-wave rank 1-2.
Copy 3+ SOL buy legs only when the campaign is fresh and first-wave rank 1-2.
Wait for a second buy within 10 seconds, then copy from the second buy onward.
Wait for three buys within 10 seconds, then copy from the third buy onward.
Copy only when pre-source actors include recurring positive lead actors from attribution.
Copy all except campaigns with recurring negative lead actors in the pre-source set.
Benchmark only: copy campaigns that eventually became rapid multi-ladders.
